column1: # r34 C1 enumeration (frozen at the preregistration): registry-and-measurement-row agreement (calibration).
# Surface (honouring Q76): every SKILL.md `## Gate registry` row and every SCORECARD.md row OUTSIDE the sections the
# r33 counter covers (`## Capabilities`, `### Round <N> capability rows`, capability currency sections) whose text
# states a runnable lane command with a current (not historical-labelled, not a red-arm pin of a frozen counter)
# numeric outcome, classified by wave-1 SwarmScout25 of round 33 (`.ufo/waves/round-33/w1/deliver-c1-enumeration-misses.md`,
# 67 rows). One item per (argv, statement) pair; argv-duplicates of an r33 K-item's restated (argv, statement) are out.
# Excluded, named in the preregistration: G06 G10 G22 G25 G27 G28 G29 G30 E02 E12 E13 E30 E35 E36 E37 (historical,
# argv-dup, no-outcome, or no-commit-cause classes) and E08b/E15b (restated by r33 rows or merged).
# Hardened over the r33 counter per lesson `## Residuals`: the statement binds to the run's LAST digit-bearing line
# unless a conjunct is marked `ANYLINE:` (multi-line claims) or `COUNT:<regex>==<n>` (line counts); the stated exit is
# fixed per item; a vacuous `RESULTS:<path>:0` is refused; an argv-correction restatement must run the row's own
# script; prior correction rows (Q76) are honoured; every run is serialized by one flock (Q77) and records host load.
# Columns: id, line (file:line at base), exit, predicate (alternatives separated by ` || `, conjuncts by ` && `),
# files (committed files the item exercises; a restatement's cause commit must touch one), at (revision the statement
# pins: {REV} = the measured revision, else a full 40-hex checked out for the run), argv (run from the private clone
# root; {SCRATCH} = fresh scratch dir; {CLONE} = the clone path; {BLOB:<rev>:<path>} = `git show` extraction into scratch).
